## Outcome
Run independent standalone Orcastrata package and workflow dogfood acceptance.

- Exact-repository workflow evidence

- An independent receipt returns ACCEPT, REVISE, or BLOCKED from package, security, consumer, and end-to-end proof.

## Dependencies

## Stop condition
Stop on a product defect, credential exposure, external-scope breach, or unapproved effect.
